Assert that the journal has been fully consumed (replay side) or
that no pending un-journalled work remains (recording side). The engine
calls this after each pulse.

name: clock
desc: Record (or replay) a clock read.

name: consumed
desc:
The number of effects consumed so far. On the recording side, this
is the number of effects written. On the replay side, it is the
number consumed from the log. ReplayEngine compares these.

name: current
desc:
The journal currently in scope, or NullJournal.instance if none is
pushed.

name: io
desc:
Record (or replay) an arbitrary I/O call. The value the caller's
run closure returns is recorded (or the recorded value is served).

name: policyTick
desc: Record (or replay) a single EphemeralPolicy tick.

name: pop
desc: Pop this journal from the stack.

name: push
desc:
Push this journal onto the stack. Must be paired with pop.
Called by JournalScope.push.

name: timer
desc:
Record (or replay) a timer firing. duration is the scheduled
window; the journal records both the schedule and the fire time so
that replay reproduces the same interleaving.

name: toJson
desc: Canonical JSON of every recorded effect, in order.

name: uuid
desc: Record (or replay) a UUID generation.

name: verdict
desc: Record (or replay) an effectful TestCell verdict.

name: EffectRecord
desc: A single recorded non-deterministic observation.

name: at
desc:
Wall-clock time of the observation. Recorded because replay needs to
reconstruct ordering; not part of the semantics of the effect.

name: fromJson
desc: Reconstructs an EffectRecord from toJson's output.

name: inputDigest
desc:
SHA-256 fingerprint of the effect's input (e.g. for Clock.now, the
fingerprint of "clock"; for IoEffect, the fingerprint of the
request).

name: kind
desc: The type tag stored in the ledger. Stable across schema versions.

name: ordinal
desc:
Monotonic ordinal within the journal, assigned by EffectJournal.
Used to assert exact consumption during replay.

name: outputDigest

SHA-256 fingerprint of the effect's output (e.g. the epoch millis
for a clock read; the response body for an I/O call).

whether a string input matches a specific Regular Expression (RegExp).

desc: If true, null values are considered valid.

desc: Executes the validation against the provided object.

name: caseSensitive

name: pattern

change, delivered as the payload of an Tissue.entryUpdated event.

interaction vectors.

name: eventLimit

The maximum threshold of events permitted before the cell is
automatically reclaimed.

Returns true if the Cell has reached its terminal state and has
been reclaimed.

A Synchronized Proxy of this box, providing thread-safe,

name: value

Thrown by ForkVerify.verify when a fork's parent ledger, fork

name: forkId
desc: The fork whose verification failed.

name: reason
desc: The failure reason.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: ForkLedgerStore

A LedgerStore wrapper that injects a synthetic ForkRecord entry
at seq 0.

desc: Append entry to the store.

name: close
desc: Close the store. Any subsequent operation must fail.

name: entriesSince
desc: Iterate entries from fromSeq (inclusive) to the end.

name: genesisHash

The fork's chain genesis. inner must have been created with this
value — CellGraphFork.fork passes it to the caller's store
factory.

Writes the synthetic seq-0 ForkRecord entry into inner without

name: ForkParentLookup

name: at

name: divergedAt
forkId

(that would defeat the point — the fork's chain must be

record itself, so the fork is identifiable by its own genesis.

name: originalLedgerId

name: originalSnapshotHash
desc:
The parent graph's snapshot hash at divergedAt. Used to bind the
fork to a specific parent state.

Verifies the fork: parent intact, fork chain intact, genesis
binding intact.
